summary: Alibaba Group furnished a Form 6-K containing a Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Return (Exhibit 99.1) reporting routine changes in issued shares due to employee equity plan vestings and option exercises. Between April 1 and April 21, 2026, Alibaba issued approximately 58.3 million new ordinary shares for nil consideration under its 2014 and 2024 equity incentive plans, including shares to a director. The filing is a standard regulatory disclosure of share capital movements, not a special-situation event. No transaction, tender offer, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is involved.
